design_intent.en: Traditional editorial design commands deep cognitive reverence through extreme scale contrast, high-fashion display serif typography, and charged white space. Meanwhile, contemporary cybernetic HUD interfaces project precision through technical monospaced telemetry, coordinate brackets, and surgical measurement lines. This study bridges these seemingly contradictory aesthetics into 'Cyber-Editorial Architecture'. By anchoring massive 120pt classical Didone/Bodoni typography against razor-sharp 1px wireframes, micro-rulers, and an interactive optical reticle cursor that reveals glyph bounding boxes and typographic stems on hover, the interface transforms the static article into an investigative aesthetic artifact.
design_intent.ko: 전통적인 고급 에디토리얼 디자인은 극단적인 활자 크기 대비, 우아한 하이패션 디스플레이 세리프, 농밀한 여백을 통해 깊은 인지적 경외감을 자아냅니다. 반면 현대적인 사이버네틱 HUD 인터페이스는 기술적 모노스페이스 수치, 좌표 괄호, 정밀 계측선을 통해 기계적 신뢰감을 전달합니다. 본 연구는 이 대립적인 두 조형 세계를 하나로 융합한 '사이버 에디토리얼 아키텍처'를 구축합니다. 120pt에 달하는 고전적 디돈/보도니 활자를 1px 극세 와이어프레임과 마이크로 자(Ruler) 사이에 배치하고, 커서 접촉 시 글자의 베이스라인과 바운딩 박스를 분해해 보여주는 대화형 광학 레티클을 장착하여 정적 웹페이지를 능동적인 디지털 유물 수사 현장으로 탈바꿈시킵니다.

visual_mechanics.name: Extreme Typographic Dialectic (Didone vs Monospace)
visual_mechanics.principle: Juxtaposing monumental 120pt Italian/French high-fashion serifs with razor-thin hairline crossbars against clinical 11px JetBrains/Geist monospaced telemetry brackets (`[SYS_METRIC_01]`, `// LAT: 40.7128° N`).

visual_mechanics.name: Optical Reticle Inspection Lens
visual_mechanics.principle: A custom hardware-accelerated cursor consisting of concentric crosshairs, coordinate readouts, and a real-time typographic bounding-box scanner that highlights x-height, ascenders, and descenders when hovering over editorial glyphs.

visual_mechanics.name: Asymmetric Dual-Chamber Canvas
visual_mechanics.principle: Dividing the viewport into an 8-column primary editorial gallery chamber and a 4-column live telemetry control rail separated by a 1px dashed datum rule, establishing dynamic visual counterpoint.

visual_mechanics.name: Chromatic Edge Fringing on Focus
visual_mechanics.principle: Applying subtle RGB channel split (1px cyan/magenta fringing) around the optical reticle glass to simulate authentic multi-element camera lens dispersion.

interaction_design.reticle_tracking: Cursor movement smoothly controls a spring-damped crosshair reticle that locks onto typographic anchor points, snapping to active section headers with tactile haptic sound synthesis.
interaction_design.lens_mode_switch: A toolbar toggle switching the optical reticle between 'Anatomical Scanner' (revealing baseline, x-height, cap-height guides) and 'Telemetry Loupe' (2x magnified pixel inspection).

typography.display: Playfair Display / Bodoni Moda, serif, weight 900
typography.telemetry: JetBrains Mono / Geist Mono, monospace, weight 400/700
